cc-devin-default-caps.description: Load a URL in the active tab. Returns a fresh snapshot after navigation.

url.description: Absolute URL to load. Subject to --allowed-domains / --blocked-domains.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_navigate_back
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Go back one entry in the active tab's history.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_tabs
cc-devin-default-caps.description: List, create, switch between, or close tabs.

index.description: Tab index (0-based) for switch/close. Defaults to active when omitted.

id.description: Tab id (e.g., t2) for switch/close. Takes precedence over index.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_click
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Click an element by ref or selector.

element.description: Human-readable element description for logging only.

target.description: Element ref like e3 from a prior browser_snapshot, OR a raw Playwright selector (css=, xpath=, text=, role=).

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_type
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Type text into an editable field. Use --humanize for natural per-character timing.

element.description: Human-readable element description for logging only.

target.description: Element ref like e3 from a prior browser_snapshot, OR a raw Playwright selector (css=, xpath=, text=, role=).

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_hover
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Hover over an element.

element.description: Human-readable element description for logging only.

target.description: Element ref like e3 from a prior browser_snapshot, OR a raw Playwright selector (css=, xpath=, text=, role=).

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_drag
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Drag from one element to another.

startTarget.description: Element ref like e3 from a prior browser_snapshot, OR a raw Playwright selector (css=, xpath=, text=, role=).

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_drop
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Drop files or data onto an element.

element.description: Human-readable element description for logging only.

target.description: Element ref like e3 from a prior browser_snapshot, OR a raw Playwright selector (css=, xpath=, text=, role=).

data.description: MIME → text payload for synthetic drag-drop.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_select_option
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Select one or more options in a <select> dropdown.

element.description: Human-readable element description for logging only.

target.description: Element ref like e3 from a prior browser_snapshot, OR a raw Playwright selector (css=, xpath=, text=, role=).

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_press_key
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Send a single key or key combination at page level.

key.description: Playwright key string, e.g. Enter, Control+A, ArrowDown.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_handle_dialog
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Respond to the next dialog (alert/confirm/prompt/beforeunload).

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_file_upload
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Upload files to the active file chooser. Paths must be inside --upload-allow-dir if set.

paths.description: Absolute file paths. Constrained to --upload-allow-dir if set.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_fill_form
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Populate multiple form fields in one call.

target.description: Element ref like e3 from a prior browser_snapshot, OR a raw Playwright selector (css=, xpath=, text=, role=).

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_scroll
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Scroll the page or an element by a pixel amount.

element.description: Human-readable element description for logging only.

target.description: Element ref like e3 from a prior browser_snapshot, OR a raw Playwright selector (css=, xpath=, text=, role=).

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_snapshot
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Capture an accessibility-tree snapshot of the active page. Returns a structured outline with [eN] refs you can pass to interaction tools.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_take_screenshot
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Capture a screenshot of the page or a specific element.

target.description: If set, screenshot just this element (ref or selector).

saveAs.description: If set, also write the image to this absolute path.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_console_messages
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Retrieve buffered console/pageerror output for the active tab.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_wait_for
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Wait for time, text appearance/disappearance, or selector state.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_resize
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Resize the viewport.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: browser_evaluate
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Run a JavaScript function inside the page. Function source must be an arrow or function expression.

function.description: JS function source: must be an arrow or function expression. Receives the page (or element) and returns a JSON-serializable value.

target.description: If set, runs the function with this element as argument.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: cloak_set_fingerprint
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Apply a fingerprint profile to the active context. Some fields (seed, GPU, screen) require recreating the context — current pages will be reopened on the same URL.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: cloak_set_timezone
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Live-override the timezone for the active context via CDP (no relaunch).

cc-devin-default-caps.name: cloak_set_locale
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Override navigator.language and Accept-Language for the active context.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: cloak_set_geolocation
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Set the geolocation reported by navigator.geolocation. Pass fromProxyIp=true to auto-resolve from proxy exit IP.

fromProxyIp.description: If true, resolve geolocation from the configured proxy's exit IP via cloak's geoip backend.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: cloak_set_proxy
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Replace the current proxy. This recreates the BrowserContext (state is preserved if --profile-dir was used; otherwise cookies are lost).

proxy.description: New proxy URL. Switching mid-session recreates the context.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: cloak_detection_test
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Load a well-known bot-detection probe page and dump its key result fields.

suite.description: Which probe to load. Default = sannysoft (free, no captchas).

cc-devin-default-caps.name: cloak_stealth_audit
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Programmatic stealth audit. Reports navigator.webdriver, plugin count, WebGL vendor/renderer, languages, user agent, hardwareConcurrency, deviceMemory, permissions, chrome.runtime presence, and a canvas fingerprint hash.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: cloak_request_signal_inspect
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Open the target URL in an ephemeral background tab and capture per-request connection signals: response status, security details (TLS protocol/issuer), response headers, and request headers (Accept-Language, User-Agent, Sec-CH-UA-*).

url.description: Target URL whose connection signals (TLS, headers) we capture.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: cloak_persistent_profile_create
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Create a fresh persistent profile directory under ~/.cloak-browser-mcp/profiles/<name>. Use as --profile-dir on next launch.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: cloak_persistent_profile_list
cc-devin-default-caps.description: List all profile directories under ~/.cloak-browser-mcp/profiles/.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: cloak_persistent_profile_delete
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Delete a profile directory. Requires confirm=true. The active session is unaffected.

confirm.description: Required — confirms you intend to wipe this profile.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: cloak_binary_info
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Report installed CloakBrowser binary version, platform, and cache path.

cc-devin-default-caps.name: cloak_binary_update
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Force CloakBrowser to check for and download the latest Chromium build. May take several minutes (~200MB).

cc-devin-default-caps.name: cloak_humanize_set
cc-devin-default-caps.description: Toggle humanized mouse/keyboard inputs and tune behavior. Takes effect on subsequent click/type calls when --caps humanize is on.

kairos.name: browser_navigate
kairos.description: Open a URL in the current tab (launches the browser if needed), or pass back / forward / reload. Returns the page snapshot with [ref=eN] handles.

url.description: Absolute URL, or back | forward | reload

kairos.name: browser_snapshot
kairos.description: Full accessibility snapshot of the current page with [ref=eN] handles. Actions already return page state; use this to see the whole page again.

kairos.name: browser_click
kairos.description: Click an element by ref. Pass x/y instead of ref to click viewport coordinates (canvas, captchas, elements missing from the snapshot).

ref.description: Ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. e12 or f1e12

kairos.name: browser_type
kairos.description: Replace the content of a text field by typing like a human. submit presses Enter afterwards.

kairos.name: browser_fill_form
kairos.description: Fill several fields in one call. checkbox/radio take "true" or "false"; combobox takes an option label or value.

kairos.name: browser_select
kairos.description: Select option(s) in a <select> by label or value.

kairos.name: browser_hover
kairos.description: Move the mouse over an element (menus, tooltips).

kairos.name: browser_drag
kairos.description: Drag one element onto another (from_ref, to_ref), or between viewport coordinates (x1, y1, x2, y2).

kairos.name: browser_press_key
kairos.description: Press a key or combination on the focused element, e.g. Enter, Escape, Tab, Control+A.

kairos.name: browser_scroll
kairos.description: Scroll by viewport heights. With ref, scroll the area under that element (inner scroll panes).

kairos.name: browser_wait_for
kairos.description: Wait for text to appear, text to disappear, or a number of seconds (max 60).

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for text, default 30

kairos.name: browser_screenshot
kairos.description: Screenshot of the viewport, the full page, or one element (ref), returned as an image. For visual checks; prefer snapshots for reading and acting.

kairos.name: browser_evaluate
kairos.description: Run JavaScript in the page and return the JSON result: an expression (document.title) or a function (() => ...). With ref, pass a function that receives the element (el => el.value).

kairos.name: browser_search_page
kairos.description: Find text in the page's visible text and return matches with context. Useful when a snapshot is truncated.

kairos.name: browser_tabs
kairos.description: List, open, select or close tabs. index is 0-based; close without index closes the current tab.

kairos.name: browser_handle_dialog
kairos.description: Accept or dismiss the open alert/confirm/prompt dialog.

kairos.name: browser_console
kairos.description: Console messages and uncaught errors of the current page (since it loaded). Without index: a list. With index: one message in full.

kairos.name: browser_network
kairos.description: Network requests for the current tab. Without index: a list (filter = URL substring). With index: one request with headers.

kairos.name: browser_profile
kairos.description: Persistent profiles keep logins, cookies and a fixed fingerprint, shared with Claude Code's cloakbrowser MCP (one browser per profile at a time). list shows them; use relaunches the browser in a profile (created if new); ephemeral relaunches with a throwaway session. proxy applies to the relaunch.

kairos.name: browser_close
kairos.description: Close the browser. The next browser tool relaunches it.
